Nina Ricci L’Air du Temps is ideal for women who enjoy floral fragrances, elegant feminine perfumes, and versatile scents with a refined classic finish. Secret Wish is perfect for free-spirited, youthful individuals who love fragrances that feel like a daydream in a bottle.. Top Notes: Lemon, Melon, Peach, Marigold Middle Notes: Pineapple, Black Currant, Floral Notes Base Notes: White Cedar Extract, Musk, Amber, Sandalwood. How to Apply: Apply it to your body's warmest points, such as the crease of your elbows and wrists, to intensify the longevity of the fragrance. listings.rawTitle: Issey Miyake L'eau D'issey 25ml Eau de Toilette Spray for Her
listings.description: L'Eau d'Issey by Issey Miyake is a Floral Aquatic fragrance for women, launched in 1992 and created by legendary perfumer Jacques Cavallier Belletrud . Fresh, elegant, and timelessly sophisticated, this iconic fragrance was inspired by the purity of water, combining airy florals, aquatic freshness, and soft woods into a scent that feels luminous, clean, and effortlessly feminine.. Conceived as a fragrance “as clear as spring water,” L’Eau d’Issey became one of the most influential aquatic florals of the 1990s, celebrated for its transparent freshness and refined simplicity.. The fragrance opens with a radiant blend of lotus, melon, freesia, rose water, rose, calone, and cyclamen . The aquatic freshness of calone and lotus creates an immediate sense of purity and freshness, while melon adds juicy softness balanced beautifully by delicate floral notes of freesia and rose.. At the heart, elegant notes of lily-of-the-valley, lily, water peony, and carnation create a graceful floral bouquet. The lilies and peony enhance the fragrance with airy floral elegance, while carnation introduces a subtle spicy warmth that adds depth and sophistication.. As the scent settles, smooth notes of musk, tuberose, exotic woods, osmanthus, cedar, sandalwood, and amber create a soft and sensual finish. The musk and woods provide warmth and longevity, while osmanthus and tuberose add creamy floral richness balanced by the smooth elegance of sandalwood and amber.. L’Eau d’Issey is ideal for women who appreciate fresh floral aquatic fragrances with clean sophistication and timeless elegance. Light, versatile, and effortlessly wearable, it works beautifully for daytime wear, office settings, and spring or summer occasions.. Fragrance Notes: . Top Notes: Lotus, Melon, Freesia, Rose Water, Rose, Calone, Cyclamen. . Middle Notes: Lily-of-the-Valley, Lily, Water Peony, Carnation. . Base Notes: Musk, Tuberose, Exotic Woods, Osmanthus, Cedar, Sandalwood, Amber. . Fragrance Type: Floral Aquatic. Launch Year: 1992. How to Apply: Apply to pulse points such as the wrists, neck, and behind the ears to maximise freshness and longevity. Avoid rubbing the fragrance into the skin after application, as this can alter the fragrance’s development. For best results, apply after moisturising or after a shower to help the scent remain soft and radiant throughout the day.. 1992..

listings.rawTitle: Estee Lauder Pure Color Lipstick Refillable 3.5g Matte 571 Independent
listings.description: Make every moment count with Estée Lauder Pure Color Matte Lipstick, a luxurious, high-performance formula designed to deliver bold, long-lasting colour with a modern, velvety matte finish. Part of the iconic Pure Color collection, this lipstick combines intense pigment with advanced care for beautifully sculpted, comfortable lips.. The rich, creamy texture glides effortlessly onto the lips, providing full, opaque coverage in just one swipe. Its plush powder complex creates a smooth, soft-focus matte finish that feels lightweight and comfortable—never dry, tight, or flaky.. Infused with Estée Lauder’s Moisture Lock Complex, this lipstick goes beyond colour to actively care for your lips. A nourishing blend of red raspberry seed oil, meadowfoam seed oil, apricot seed oil, and Salicornia herbacea extract helps hydrate, condition, and maintain moisture over time. The result is lips that feel soft, smooth, and visibly plumper—even after the lipstick is removed.. Designed for performance, Pure Color Matte Lipstick offers up to 10 hours of colour-true wear, resisting bleeding, feathering, and creasing. Its long-lasting formula ensures your lip look stays flawless from day to night, making it ideal for both everyday wear and special occasions.. The expertly sculpted bullet shape allows for precise application, helping you define and contour your lips with ease for a polished, professional finish.. Available in a wide range of shades—from classic reds and soft nudes to bold berries—this lipstick is designed to flatter all skin tones and suit every mood and style.. Key Benefits:. High-pigment matte lipstick with full coverage. Up to 10-hour long-lasting, colour-true wear. Plush, velvety matte finish with lightweight feel. Infused with Moisture Lock Complex for hydration. Nourishes and smooths lips while enhancing fullness. Resists bleeding, feathering, and creasing. Precision bullet for effortless application. How to Apply: Start with clean, moisturised lips.. For precise definition: Outline lips with a liner or use the bullet tip to shape the lips.. For full coverage: Apply directly from the centre outward for even colour.. For added intensity: Layer as needed to build a bold, statement look.. For best results: Reapply throughout the day to maintain a fresh, flawless finish.. Elevate your lip routine with Estée Lauder Pure Color Matte Lipstick—a perfect blend of bold colour, lasting comfort, and luxurious care.. .

Combining luxury with sustainability, this reusable case offers a stylish and practical way to customise your lip collection.. Crafted with a modern, ergonomic design, the case fits comfortably in your hand, allowing for easy, precise application on the go. Its durable, protective structure keeps your lipstick secure while maintaining a polished, high-end look. Finished with the signature Fenty logo engraving, it’s available in chic matte and metallic styles to suit your personal aesthetic.. Designed for versatility, this refillable case allows you to switch shades effortlessly, making it a timeless companion as your makeup preferences evolve. Instead of replacing the entire product, simply insert a new lipstick refill—reducing waste while maintaining your signature style.. Perfect for travel or everyday use, the compact design ensures your lipstick stays protected while remaining easy to access for quick touch-ups throughout the day.. Key Benefits:. Refillable lipstick case for sustainable beauty. Sleek, ergonomic design for comfortable use. Durable and protective for on-the-go application. Customisable with interchangeable lipstick refills. Signature Fenty logo with matte or metallic finishes. Compact, stylish, and travel-friendly. How to Apply (Assemble & Refill): Ensure your lipstick refill is ready before assembling.. To assemble: Attach the lipstick refill to the base until it clicks securely, then insert into the case until it locks into place.. To refill: Remove the existing refill, attach a new shade to the base, and insert back into the case.. For best results: Always twist the bullet fully down before inserting or removing to avoid damage.. Please note: The lipstick refill and case are sold separately.. Upgrade your makeup collection with the Fenty Beauty Icon Lipstick Case—a reusable, stylish solution for effortless, customisable lip colour..

listings.rawTitle: Isadora Lip Desire Sculpting Lipstick 3.3g - 73 Vintage Rose
listings.description: Define and enhance your lips with IsaDora Lip Desire Sculpting Lipstick, a luxurious formula designed to deliver intense colour, hydration, and precise contouring in one effortless step. Perfect for creating a sculpted, fuller-looking pout, this lipstick combines high-performance pigment with nourishing care.. The rich, creamy texture glides smoothly onto the lips, providing full, even coverage in just one swipe. Its highly pigmented formula delivers vibrant, long-lasting colour—such as deep mulberry tones—making it ideal for both everyday elegance and bold statement looks.. Infused with shea butter, jojoba oil, and vitamin E, this lipstick helps to hydrate and condition the lips, keeping them soft, smooth, and comfortable throughout the day. The nourishing blend ensures your lips stay moisturised without dryness or tightness.. Designed with a precision sculpting tip, the lipstick allows for effortless shaping and definition. The flexible, angled design hugs the contours of your lips, making it easy to outline, fill, and perfect your lip shape without the need for additional tools.. The velvety satin finish adds a refined, polished look while maintaining a comfortable feel, giving your lips a sophisticated, luminous appearance.. Key Benefits:. Sculpting lipstick for defined, fuller-looking lips. Rich, highly pigmented colour payoff. Creamy, smooth-glide formula for easy application. Hydrates with shea butter, jojoba oil, and vitamin E. Precision tip for contouring and shaping. Comfortable satin finish with long-lasting wear. How to Apply: Start with clean, exfoliated lips.. For precise definition: Use the sculpting tip to outline your lips, starting at the cupid’s bow.. For full coverage: Apply directly from the centre outward for even colour.. For enhanced shape: Pair with a lip liner for extra definition.. For best results: Blot lightly to set the colour or layer for increased intensity.. Create beautifully sculpted, hydrated lips with IsaDora Lip Desire Sculpting Lipstick—a perfect blend of colour, comfort, and precision for a flawless finish every time..

listings.rawTitle: Laura Mercier Flawless Fusion Ultra Longwear 7ml Concealer - 6W
listings.description: Perfect your complexion with Laura Mercier Flawless Fusion Ultra-Longwear Concealer in Rich with Warm Undertones, a lightweight yet high-performance formula designed to deliver seamless, long-lasting coverage. Ideal for brightening under-eyes and concealing imperfections, this concealer provides a flawless, natural finish that lasts all day.. The medium-to-full buildable coverage effortlessly camouflages dark circles, blemishes, and uneven skin tone while maintaining a smooth, skin-like appearance. Its weightless texture blends seamlessly, ensuring comfortable wear without feeling heavy or cakey.. Powered by Skin Fusion Technology, this concealer uses flexible polymers that fuse to the skin, delivering up to 12 hours of long-lasting wear. It is resistant to sweat, humidity, water, and transfer, ensuring your makeup stays fresh and intact throughout the day.. Infused with a Blurring Powder Blend, the formula helps diffuse light to soften the appearance of fine lines and imperfections, creating a refined, soft-focus effect. The result is smoother-looking skin with a natural, radiant finish that doesn’t settle into creases.. Designed to hydrate while it conceals, this concealer provides all-day comfort and helps prevent dryness, making it suitable for a variety of skin types. Its oil-free formula ensures a balanced, breathable feel, perfect for everyday wear.. Key Benefits:. Medium-to-full buildable coverage. Up to 12-hour long-lasting wear. Lightweight, breathable, and comfortable formula. Crease-resistant with soft-focus blurring effect. Transfer-, sweat-, humidity-, and water-resistant. Hydrating and oil-free formula. Ideal for under-eye brightening and concealing imperfections. How to Apply: Start with clean, moisturised skin.. For under-eye brightening: Apply small dots under the eyes and blend gently using a sponge, brush, or fingertips.. For targeted coverage: Apply to blemishes or uneven areas and blend seamlessly.. For more coverage: Build in thin layers as needed.. For best results: Set lightly with powder to enhance longevity and maintain a smooth finish.. Achieve a flawless, natural-looking complexion with Laura Mercier Flawless Fusion Concealer—a long-wearing, weightless essential for smooth, radiant, and perfected skin.

listings.rawTitle: La Perla Matte Silk Lipstick 3.5g - 110 Cinnamon Red
listings.description: Make a lasting impression with La Perla Matte Silk Lipstick, a luxurious, high-impact lipstick designed to deliver bold colour with a refined, silk-like finish. Perfect for day-to-night wear, this sophisticated formula enhances your natural beauty while offering modern comfort and elegance.. Imparting intense colour in just one smooth swipe, this is a matte lipstick—but with a difference. The innovative Matte Silk formula combines rich pigment with glossy emollients to create a soft-focus, luminous matte finish that feels as smooth as a second skin. The result is lips that look sculpted, defined, and effortlessly polished.. Unlike traditional matte lipsticks, this formula hugs the lips with lightweight, barely-there comfort, ensuring all-day wear without dryness or heaviness. Infused with a carefully selected blend of nourishing oils, emollients, and gentle waxes, it works to restore suppleness, improve the skin barrier, and deeply hydrate.. Enhanced with vitamin E, the formula provides antioxidant protection while soothing and conditioning the lips. The addition of silk-like light-reflecting particles ensures a subtle luminosity that elevates the colour without compromising the matte effect.. This lipstick is also vegan, gluten-free, and clean, formulated without talc, fragrance, parabens, D5 silicones, or alcohol—making it a conscious choice for those who value both performance and purity.. Encased in a sleek, luxurious bullet, La Perla Matte Silk Lipstick embodies elegance and indulgence, making it a perfect addition to your beauty routine or a thoughtful gift.. Key Benefits:. Bold, high-impact colour in one swipe. Unique matte-silk finish with soft luminosity. Lightweight, second-skin comfort. Hydrates and restores lip softness. Infused with vitamin E and nourishing emollients. Vegan, gluten-free, and clean formula. Long-lasting, non-drying wear. How to Apply: Start with clean, smooth lips.. For precise definition: Outline lips using the angled tip, focusing on the cupid’s bow.. For full coverage: Apply from the centre outward in smooth strokes.. For added intensity: Layer as needed for a deeper, more defined look.. For best results: Reapply lightly to maintain a fresh, polished finish.. Embrace modern luxury with La Perla Matte Silk Lipstick—a sensual, second-skin formula that delivers bold colour, comfort, and timeless elegance..

Combining intense pigment with nourishing ingredients, this refillable lipstick offers both luxury and sustainability in one sleek design.. The creamy, lightweight formula glides effortlessly onto the lips, providing full coverage in a single swipe. Its semi-matte finish strikes the perfect balance between soft sheen and matte, giving lips a plush, velvety look that feels comfortable all day.. Infused with hyaluronic acid and vitamins C and E, this lipstick helps to hydrate, condition, and protect the lips while maintaining bold colour payoff. The formula locks in moisture, ensuring your lips feel smooth, soft, and never dry.. Designed for precision, the Cupid’s bow-inspired bullet shape allows for effortless application, helping you define and shape your lips with ease. Whether you're creating a sharp, polished look or a softer, diffused finish, this lipstick adapts to your style.. The refillable design makes it an eco-conscious choice, allowing you to replace your lipstick without discarding the entire case. Available in a range of wearable shades, from classic reds to everyday neutrals, it suits all skin tones and occasions.. Key Benefits:. High-pigment lipstick with semi-matte finish. Creamy, lightweight, and comfortable formula. Hydrates with hyaluronic acid and vitamins C & E. Full coverage with smooth, even application. Precision bullet for easy shaping. Refillable design for sustainable beauty. How to Apply: Start with clean, dry lips.. For a natural look: Tap the lipstick onto lips for a soft wash of colour.. For full coverage: Apply directly from the bullet, starting at the centre and blending outward.. For definition: Use a lip liner to outline lips before application.. For best results: Blot lightly for a softer finish or layer for more intensity.. Elevate your lip routine with Fenty Beauty Icon Semi-Matte Refillable Lipstick—a bold, nourishing formula that delivers vibrant colour, lasting comfort, and sustainable style.. . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . .

listings.rawTitle: Laura Mercier Caviar Stick 1.64g  Eye Colour - Rush
listings.description: Create effortless, long-lasting eye looks with Laura Mercier Caviar Stick Eye Colour, a creamy eyeshadow stick designed for seamless application and high-impact colour. This versatile formula glides smoothly onto the lids, delivering rich pigment with a crease-free, smudge-proof finish that lasts up to 12 hours.. The creamy, blendable texture allows for easy application, making it perfect for both quick everyday looks and more defined, smoky styles. Whether used alone or layered with other shadows, this stick provides a smooth, even finish that enhances your eyes with minimal effort.. Available in a wide range of shades and finishes, including shimmering tones, the Caviar Stick can be used to define, line, highlight, or create depth, making it a true multi-use essential. Its buildable formula allows you to customise intensity—from a soft wash of colour to a bold, dramatic look.. Designed for performance, the formula sets quickly and stays in place without creasing, flaking, or fading. It works beautifully on bare lids or as a base for powder or liquid eyeshadows, helping to enhance colour payoff and longevity.. Consumer-tested results highlight its performance:. 100% agreed it glides smoothly onto the eyelids. 94% said it feels comfortable and long-lasting. 94% reported no fallout or flaking. 91% experienced high-colour impact. Key Benefits:. Creamy eyeshadow stick with smooth, glide-on application. Up to 12-hour long-lasting, crease-free wear. Smudge-proof, fade-resistant formula. Buildable colour for natural or dramatic looks. Multi-use: line, define, highlight, or base. Available in a variety of shades and finishes. How to Apply: Start with clean, dry eyelids.. For all-over colour: Apply directly to the lid and blend with fingertips or a brush.. For definition: Use along the lash line for a soft, smoky liner effect.. For best results: Blend quickly after application, as the formula sets fast.. Pro tip: Mix matte and shimmer shades for added depth and dimension.. Elevate your eye makeup routine with Laura Mercier Caviar Stick Eye Colour—a long-wear, easy-to-use essential for effortless, polished eye looks.. . . . . . . . . . . .

listings.rawTitle: Lottie Glossip Girl Full Coverage 8ml Colour Gloss - Hype
listings.description: Make a bold statement with Lottie London Glossip Girl Full Coverage Lip Gloss in Hashtag, a high-impact gloss designed to deliver rich colour with a glass-like shine. Perfect for those who love standout lips, this formula combines full coverage with a lightweight, comfortable feel.. The creamy, non-sticky texture glides effortlessly onto the lips, providing smooth, even application with intense pigment in just one swipe. Shade Hashtag is a bold, versatile tone that flatters a wide range of skin tones, making it ideal for both everyday wear and statement looks.. Designed for comfort and performance, this gloss helps smooth the appearance of lip texture while enhancing the natural shape of your lips for a fuller-looking finish. The lightweight formula ensures long-lasting wear without heaviness, keeping your lips feeling soft and comfortable throughout the day.. The high-shine, glassy finish reflects light beautifully, giving your lips a polished, luminous look that stands out in any setting—from casual daytime wear to evening glam. Its long-lasting formula helps resist feathering and settling into fine lines, ensuring your colour stays vibrant and defined.. The precision applicator allows for controlled, effortless application, helping you define the lip line and distribute product evenly for a flawless finish.. Key Benefits:. Full-coverage lip gloss with intense colour payoff. High-shine, glass-like finish. Lightweight, non-sticky, and comfortable formula. Smooths and enhances lip texture. Long-lasting wear with minimal feathering. Versatile shade suitable for all skin tones. How to Apply: Start with clean, smooth lips.. For bold colour: Apply directly from the wand, starting at the centre and blending outward.. For a softer look: Dab lightly with your fingertip for a diffused finish.. For added definition: Pair with a lip liner for crisp edges.. For best results: Reapply as needed or layer over lipstick for added shine and dimension.. Elevate your lip look with Lottie London Glossip Girl Lip Gloss in Hashtag—a bold, glossy essential for high-impact colour and luminous shine..

listings.rawTitle: Buxom 1.5g Single Eyeshadow Bar -  Unapologetic
listings.description: Create custom eye looks with ease using the Buxom Single Eyeshadow Bar, a primer-infused eyeshadow designed to deliver rich, high-impact colour with long-lasting performance. Perfect for building your own palette or adding a statement shade to your collection, this versatile eyeshadow offers professional results with effortless application.. The silky, smooth formula glides seamlessly onto the lids, providing intense pigment in a single swipe. Infused with built-in primer technology, it helps lock in colour for crease-resistant, fade-proof wear, ensuring your eye look stays vibrant throughout the day and night.. Available in a variety of finishes—including matte, satin, shimmer, and metallic—the Eyeshadow Bar allows you to customise your look with ease. Whether you prefer soft, everyday tones or bold, dramatic shades, this collection adapts to your style.. Designed with convenience in mind, each shadow comes in a magnetised pan, making it easy to slot into refillable palettes. This innovative system lets you mix, match, and curate your own selection of shades for a truly personalised makeup experience.. The lightweight, blendable texture ensures smooth application and seamless transitions between colours, making it ideal for both beginners and makeup enthusiasts.. Key Benefits:. Primer-infused eyeshadow for long-lasting wear. Highly pigmented, buildable colour payoff. Smooth, blendable formula for effortless application. Available in multiple finishes (matte, shimmer, metallic, satin). Magnetised pan for customisable palettes. Compact, travel-friendly design. How to Apply: Start with primed eyelids for best results.. For all-over colour: Use a fluffy brush to sweep across the lid.. For intense pigment: Use a flat brush or fingertip to press colour onto the lid.. For blending: Use a clean brush to soften edges and create a seamless finish.. For added dimension: Layer shades or use a damp brush to intensify shimmer or metallic finishes.. Build your perfect palette with Buxom Single Eyeshadow Bar—a customisable, high-performance eyeshadow designed for vibrant colour and endless creativity..

The innovative formula is infused with moisture-coated powder pigments, allowing the lipstick to glide smoothly across the lips while delivering buildable, full-coverage colour. The result is a diffused matte effect that softens the appearance of lip lines, creating a smooth, airbrushed finish.. Despite its matte look, this lipstick provides up to 12 hours of comfortable wear without drying, cracking, or flaking. It helps keep lips feeling hydrated and supple, with continued use improving the overall smoothness and softness of your lips.. The sleek, slim-stick design allows for precise application, making it easy to define your lip shape or create a soft, blurred effect. Whether you prefer a subtle wash of colour or a bold statement lip, this versatile formula adapts to your desired look.. Engineered for long-lasting performance, the formula is fade-resistant, non-bleeding, non-feathering, and crease-resistant, ensuring your lip colour stays flawless throughout the day.. Key Benefits:. Soft-focus matte lipstick with blurred finish. Up to 12-hour long-lasting, comfortable wear. Moisture-coated pigments for smooth application. Blurs and smooths the appearance of lip lines. Lightweight, non-drying, and non-flaking formula. Slim design for precise and easy application. How to Apply: Start with clean, smooth lips.. For full coverage: Apply directly from the stick, starting at the centre and gliding outward.. For a blurred look: Tap and blend with your fingertip for a soft-focus effect.. For best results: Layer as needed to build intensity while maintaining a smooth finish.. Pro tip: Prep lips with a lip primer for a smoother base and more defined edges.. Elevate your lip game with MAC Powder Kiss Velvet Blur Slim Stick Lipstick—a modern matte that delivers bold colour, soft texture, and all-day comfort in one effortless swipe.. . . . . . . . .

listings.rawTitle: MAC Studio Fix Every-Wear 12ml All-Over Face Pen  - NC20
listings.description: Perfect your complexion with MAC Studio Fix Every-Wear All Over Face Pen Corrector, a multi-use, high-performance complexion pen designed for targeted correction or full-face coverage. This innovative, travel-friendly pen delivers medium-to-full buildable coverage with a natural matte finish for a smooth, flawless look that lasts all day.. The lightweight formula blends seamlessly into the skin, helping to conceal dark circles, blemishes, redness, and uneven tone while maintaining a breathable, comfortable feel. Designed to resist creasing, streaking, and caking, it ensures a polished finish that looks natural and refined.. Infused with vitamin E, hyaluronic acid, and caffeine, this formula not only provides coverage but also cares for your skin. Vitamin E helps condition and protect, hyaluronic acid delivers hydration, and caffeine works to reduce the appearance of puffiness and brighten the under-eye area.. Engineered for durability, this concealer pen offers transfer-proof, waterproof wear for up to 36 hours, making it ideal for long days, busy schedules, and on-the-go touch-ups. The built-in precision brush tip allows for controlled, mess-free application, ensuring seamless blending wherever you need it.. Available in a wide range of shades, this versatile product can be used to conceal, highlight, contour, or even out the entire complexion, making it a true all-in-one essential.. Key Benefits:. Multi-use pen: conceal, correct, highlight, and contour. Medium-to-full buildable coverage. Natural matte, smooth finish. Up to 36-hour waterproof, transfer-proof wear. Crease-, streak-, and caking-resistant. Infused with vitamin E, hyaluronic acid, and caffeine. Built-in brush tip for easy, precise application. How to Apply: Start with clean, moisturised skin.. For targeted correction: Click the pen to dispense product and apply directly to areas such as under eyes, blemishes, or redness.. For blending: Tap gently with a sponge, brush, or fingertip for a seamless finish.. For highlighting/contouring: Use a lighter shade to brighten and a deeper shade to sculpt, then blend well.. For best results: Set with powder if desired for extended wear and a more matte finish.. Elevate your base routine with MAC Studio Fix Every-Wear All Over Face Pen—a versatile, long-wearing solution for a flawless, smooth, and perfected complexion anytime, anywhere..

listings.rawTitle: MAC Locked Kiss 24HR 1.8g Lipstick - 60 Mull It Over + Over
listings.description: Experience unstoppable colour with MAC Locked Kiss 24HR Lipstick, a high-performance matte lipstick designed for intense pigment, long-lasting wear, and all-day comfort. Delivering up to 24 hours of transfer-proof, smudge-resistant colour, this innovative formula keeps your lips looking flawless from morning to night.. The buttery-soft texture glides effortlessly onto the lips, providing smooth, even coverage in a single swipe. Once applied, it sets into a flexible matte finish that moves with your lips—never feeling dry, tight, or uncomfortable.. Infused with passion fruit oil, shea butter, and coconut oil, this lipstick helps nourish and condition your lips throughout wear. These hydrating ingredients work to maintain softness and prevent dryness, ensuring your lips stay smooth and comfortable even after hours of use.. Designed for durability, MAC Locked Kiss Lipstick is transfer-proof, smudge-resistant, and fade-resistant, meaning it stays locked in place without the need for constant touch-ups. Whether you're eating, drinking, or on the go, your lip colour remains vibrant and defined.. Available in a wide range of shades—from flattering everyday nudes to bold statement reds—this lipstick offers something for every mood and occasion. Its high-impact colour and long-wear performance make it a must-have for those who want reliable, fearless lip colour.. Key Benefits:. Up to 24-hour long-lasting wear. Transfer-proof, smudge-resistant, and fade-resistant. Buttery-soft texture with smooth application. Flexible matte finish that feels comfortable. Infused with nourishing oils and butters. Available in a wide range of bold and wearable shades. How to Apply: Start with clean, smooth lips.. Prep: Exfoliate and apply a light layer of lip balm, then blot off excess.. Apply: Swipe directly onto lips, starting from the centre and blending outward.. Define (optional): Use a lip liner to outline and enhance your lip shape.. Set: Allow a few seconds for the formula to lock in for long-lasting wear.. Make a statement with MAC Locked Kiss 24HR Lipstick—a bold, high-performance matte formula that delivers lasting colour, comfort, and confidence in every swipe..
